newsitem.title: USA: Household Finance files for $3 bln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Household Finance files for $3 bln in notes.

text.p: Household Finance Corp, part of the Household International Inc group, said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $3 billion in medium-term notes.
The company will make the offering through Merrill Lynch & Co and UBS Securities LLC.
The notes will be due nine months or more from date of issue, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be applied to Household's general funds to be used in its finance services business, including funding of investments in or extension of credit to affiliates of Household Finance Corp, the filing said.
The company and its affiates offers a diversified range of financial services. HFC is headquarted in Prospects Heights, Ill.
